capabilities: Encrypt notes and attachments with one master password
Edit sealed Markdown and text notes inside the plugin
Store logins in a secrets manager with groups, tags, links and templates
Create a recovery key and unlock vault-keyed files once per session
extras: No account or server; encryption runs on the device. File names, sizes and folder structure stay visible, and an unlocked session is not protected from malware or other plugins. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; without a usable keyring plus a password or recovery key, sealed files cannot be recovered. Format, threat model and a local recovery tool are documented outside the README.
problem: Notes and attachments sit in the vault as readable plain text, so anyone with access to the files can open them.
summary: Encryption plugin that seals notes and attachments as .sealed files, edits them inside Obsidian, and keeps logins in a built-in secrets manager.
